ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels across the central ventral surface with 15% low-intensity black pixels localized at the perimeter and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central field. Continuous black pigmentation band along the trailing edge and lobe tips. Localized black mottling and focal spots concentrated on the left lobe and the lower-central peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular topography. The left lobe exhibits high-amplitude excisions including one deep, roughly rectangular notch. The right lobe exhibits a high-frequency, low-amplitude serration pattern along its entire length.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curve for both lobes, significantly interrupted on the left side by macro-scale trailing edge tissue loss.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of 15+ circular, high-contrast scarring patterns (dark outlines with light centers) localized on the upper-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detected diagonal linear pixel disruption on the lower-left quadrant; faint horizontal parallel lines (rake marks) visible on the mid-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant macro-scale tissue loss/trauma on the trailing edge of the left lobe (large rectangular notch). Extensive circular barnacle attachment scars present across the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique deep vertical notch on the inner-left portion of the trailing edge, approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
